blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Much knowledge work produces new deliverables from files a workspace already holds, and LLM agents are beginning to take such work over. Through direct corpus interaction, an agent can search and read any of those files from a terminal with no indexing, and producing a deliverable from many of them in this way is what we call direct workspace interaction (DWI). Reaching the files, however, is only half the task: nothing keeps track of what the task asks for, what has been read, and what was listed but never opened, all of which slip through the context window without leaving a trace, so an agent may extract a figure and still deliver a report without it. To address this, we present RunningTab, a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab : a per-task record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment alongside the agent. Specifically, the agent adds its requirements, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every listed but unopened file as a candidate; the agent can then see each requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and top unopened candidates, resolve it against matching content or set it aside with a reason, and, should it try to finish with requirements still open, receive them in a finish check. We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks with three LLMs, where it consistently outperforms plain DWI and baselines that keep the record in the model, while its tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen.
blocks.zh: 许多知识工作从一个工作空间已经掌握的档案中产生了新的可交付成果,LLM代理商开始接手这项工作。 通过直接实体交互,一个代理可以从一个终端中搜索并读取其中的任何文件,而不进行索引,用这种方式从其中的许多终端中生成一个交付品,这就是我们所说的直接工作空间交互(DWI). 然而,到达文件只是一半的任务:没有任何东西能追踪任务要求的内容,被读到的内容,以及被列出但从未打开的内容,这些内容都从上下文窗口中滑出而未留下痕迹,因此代理商可以提取出一个数字,在没有它的情况下仍然会递交报告. 为了解决这个问题,我们介绍了RunningTab,这个框架为直接的工作空间互动配备了环境-侧标签:每个任务记录任务还欠多少,由环境与代理保存。 具体地说,代理商增加了其要求,而环境记录了每个文件作为摘录读取,其出处和所有列出但尚未打开的文件作为候选人;代理商然后可以在最佳匹配的节录和顶端未打开的候选者之外看到每个要求,根据匹配内容解决,或以某种理由将其搁置,如果它试图完成仍然开放的要求,则在完成检查时收到这些要求。 我们在三个基准上验证了RunningTab,有三个LLMs,它的业绩始终高于平地的DWI和在模型中保持记录的基线,而它的分页则通常持有一旦看到可交付的需求。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Much of the work in an organization consists of producing new deliverables from files it already holds (the reports, spreadsheets, slide decks, and notes accumulated over years in a shared workspace) ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Patwardhan et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) : a hiring summary is compiled from resumes and interview notes; a budget review is built from a year of monthly spreadsheets; a project proposal is drafted from meeting notes and a previous contract. Large Language Model (LLM) agents that operate a computer autonomously ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) make it possible to hand such work over end to end, so that the agent itself locates the relevant files, reads them, and writes the deliverable. A workspace task, then, is not a single retrieval but an accumulation over a long horizon: the deliverable brings together content scattered across many files, and the agent must reach each of them before it can write.
blocks.zh: 一个组织的大部分工作包括从它已经拥有的文档(报告、电子表格、幻灯片和多年来在共享工作空间积累的说明)中产生新的可交付成果(徐等,2025年a;Patwardhan等,2025年;Tang等,2026年):从简历和访谈说明中汇编征聘摘要;根据一年的月度电子表格进行预算审查;根据会议说明和先前的合同起草项目提案。 自主操作计算机的大型语言模型(LLM)代理(姚等,2023;史克等,2023;杨等,2024;梅里尔等,2026)使得将此类工作交接到底成为可能,使代理自己找到相关文件,阅读,并写出交付品. 因此,一个工作空间任务并不是一个单一的检索,而是在很长的地平线上的积累:可交付文件将分散在许多文件上的内容汇集在一起,代理必须到达每个文件后才能写出.

blocks.en: To reach the existing files, direct corpus interaction ( Li et al., 2026b ) opens the road: instead of a retriever over a prebuilt index ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ) , the agent works in a terminal and applies standard command-line utilities (listing a directory, searching for a term across files, opening a document) directly to the raw files, so that any file in the workspace can be reached as it is, with no indexing or preprocessing. Subsequent work scales it to larger corpora ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , synthesizes tasks for it ( Salemi et al., 2026 ) , and studies how agents search under it ( Sen et al., 2026 ; Subramanian et al., 2026 ) . However, when the corpus is such a workspace and the goal is not a short answer to a question but a new deliverable assembled from many of its files, the agent has to work inside the workspace over many steps and hand in the deliverable at the end; we refer to this setting as direct workspace interaction (DWI). Yet reaching the files is only half the task.
blocks.zh: 为了达到现有的文件,直接实体交互(Li等,2026b)打开了道路:代替一个取回器通过一个预建的索引(Karpukhin等,2020;Lewis等,2020),代理在终端工作,并将标准指令行公用事业(列出目录,搜索一个名词跨出文件,打开一个文件)直接应用到原始文件,这样工作空间中的任何文件都可以按原样到达,没有索引或预处理. 随后的工作将它缩放到更大的蝎子上(Lu等,2026年),为它综合了任务(Salemi等,2026年),并研究了毒剂如何在其下搜索(Sen等,2026年;Subramanian等,2026年). 但是,当委托书是这样一个工作空间,而且目标不是对一个问题的简短回答,而是从其许多文件中汇集的新交付品时,代理人必须在工作空间内就许多步骤开展工作,并在最后交出交付品;我们把这种背景称为直接的工作空间互动(DWI)。 然而,到达文件只是一半的任务。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Direct workspace interaction (DWI) and RunningTab on an illustrative task: a brief that needs three facts scattered across a workspace. (Left) In DWI, the agent reaches every file through its terminal, but what it reads lives only in its context window: facts read early are displaced by later observations, and the brief is delivered without them. (Right) RunningTab keeps an environment-side tab beside the agent: the agent adds the requirements of the task, the environment records what is read and what is listed but not opened, and the facts remain available until the deliverable is written.
blocks.zh: 图1:直接工作空间互动(DWI)和RunningTab关于一个说明性任务:一个需要分散在一个工作空间的三个事实的简要说明. (left)在 DWI 中,代理通过终端到达每个文件,但是它所读到的只是其上下文窗口中的生活: 早期读取的事实被后期的观察所取代,而简报是在没有它们的情况下送达的. (右) RunningTab 在代理机旁边设置了环境侧标签:代理机添加了任务的要求,环境记录了读取的内容和列出但未打开的内容,在可交付文件被写入之前,事实仍然可用.

blocks.en: The agent has full access to the workspace, but nothing keeps track of the task it is carrying out. What the task asks for, which files have been read, and which were listed but never opened pass through the context window and are soon displaced by new observations; nothing records which of them have been used, and nothing connects a requirement of the task to the file that satisfies it. As a consequence, an agent may open the right annual report, extract the figure it needs into its observations, and still deliver a report without that figure; or it may list a folder that contains the relevant file and never open it. What is missing, we argue, is a record of what the task still owes, kept by the environment and available to the agent whenever it needs it.
blocks.zh: 特工可以完全进入工作空间,但没有任何东西能跟踪它正在完成的任务. 任务要求什么,哪些文件已经被读取,哪些被列出但从未打开过的文件通过上下文窗口,很快被新的观察所取代;没有记录其中哪些被使用,也没有将任务的要求与满足它的文件联系起来. 因此,代理人可以打开正确的年度报告,将其需要的数字提取到观察中,并且仍然在没有该数字的情况下提交报告;或者可以列出一个包含相关文件的文件夹,而永远不会打开. 我们争辩说,所缺少的是一份记录,其中记录了任务仍然欠下、由环境保管、并随时随地可供代理人使用的情况。

blocks.en: In this work, we present RunningTab , a framework that equips direct workspace interaction with an environment-side tab : a per-task running record that the environment maintains for the agent ( Figure 1 ). Specifically, the agent adds one requirement per fact, figure, or element the task asks for, while the environment records every file read as an excerpt with its provenance and every file listed but not opened as a candidate , further ranked by its relevance to the task. Because the tab keeps what would otherwise have passed out of view, the agent can consult it freely, returning to a stored excerpt or a listed file whenever it needs them instead of searching the workspace again. Furthermore, before resolving any requirement, the agent lists them and sees each open one beside its best-matching excerpts and its top unopened candidates, and a requirement is resolved only against an excerpt whose content matches it, or with a reason it cannot be met; should the agent attempt to finish with items open, the environment returns them once, in a finish check . The tab thus runs alongside the task, from the first requirement the agent writes to the finish check, holding what the model would otherwise have to retain and pointing back to the files it came from.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了RunningTab ,这个框架为直接的工作空间互动配备了环境侧标签:环境为代理机维护的每任务运行记录(图1). 具体地说,代理商每个事实、数字或任务要求的元素都增加了一项要求,而环境记录每个文件作为摘录阅读,其中附有其出处,以及所有列出但没有作为候选人打开的文件,进一步按其与任务的相关性排序。 由于分页保留了本来会从视图中掉出的东西,代理可以自由查阅,在需要的时候返回存储的节录或列表文件,而不是再次搜索工作空间. 此外,在解决任何要求之前,代理商列出这些要求,并在最匹配的节录及其顶端未打开的候选者之外看到每个开放的节录,而一项要求只能根据内容与之相匹配的节录解决,或以无法满足的原因解决;如果代理商试图用打开的物品完成,则环境会在最后检查中返回一次。 因此,标签与任务同时运行,从第一个要求代理写到完成检查,持有模型要保留什么,并指向它来自的文件。

blocks.en: We validate RunningTab on three benchmarks ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ) with three LLMs, where it improves over plain DWI and baselines in which the model itself keeps track of the task, in every case. Ablations attribute most of this gain to what the environment captures on its own, the tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once the agent has seen them, and the gain grows with how much the agent reads. These results affirm that direct workspace interaction needs more than access to the files: the terminal reaches them, and the environment-side tab keeps what the task owes until it is delivered.
blocks.zh: 我们在三个基准(Tang等人,2026年;徐等人,2025年a;Opsahl-Ong等人,2026年)上验证了RunningTab,在这三个基准上,它比平地的DWI和基准改进,模型本身在每一个基准中都跟踪任务。 缩放将大部分收益归结于环境本身所捕获的东西,标签通常在代理看到时会持有可交付需求值,而收益随着代理读取量的增加而增长. 这些结果证实,直接的工作空间互动需要的不仅仅是访问文件:终端到达了它们,环境侧标签保留了任务所欠的,直到交付.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LLM agents that operate a computer have shown strong performance as software developers and terminal users ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) and are evaluated in terminal and desktop environments ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) . Building on these agents, recent benchmarks bring them to knowledge work: they pose tasks over realistic office and enterprise workspaces and judge the deliverable the agent produces ( Xu et al., 2025a ; Patwardhan et al., 2025 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . However, these studies find that the deliverables often lack content the workspace holds: Xu et al. (2025a) attribute failures in part to a lack of ability to understand documents, and Tang et al. (2026) name heterogeneous file understanding and lineage tracing as the bottlenecks. These diagnoses concern reaching and reading the files, whereas our own analysis (discussed in Section 3.1 with Figure 2 ) takes a different lens and finds a loss that these diagnoses do not cover: content from files the agent had already opened, which appeared in its observations yet is missing from the deliverable. In this work, we address this part directly, by keeping beside the agent a record of what the task still owes and of what has been read, so that content once reached is not lost before delivery.
blocks.zh: 操作计算机的LLM代理商作为软件开发者和终端用户表现出了强大的性能(Yang等,2024;Wang等,2025),并在终端和桌面环境中受到评价(Merrill等,2026;Xie等,2024). 以这些代理人为基础,最近的基准使这些代理人从事知识工作:他们的任务超越现实的办公室和企业的工作空间,并判断代理人的交付品(徐等,2025a;Patwardhan等,2025;唐等,2026;王等,2024;Opsahl-Ong等,2026;Chen等,2026)。 然而,这些研究发现,可交付成果往往缺乏工作空间拥有的内容: 许等 (2025a)将失败部分归因于缺乏理解文件的能力,而唐等也认为. (2026) 将不同文件的理解和家族追踪作为瓶颈。 这些诊断涉及到达和阅读文件,而我们自己的分析(第3.1节同图2一起讨论)则采用不同的视角,发现这些诊断没有涵盖的损失:从代理人已经打开的文件来看,其内容在其观察中出现,但在交付品中却缺失。 在这项工作中,我们直接处理这一部分,除了代理人外,还要记录任务仍然存在和已读到的内容,以便在交付前不会丢失内容。

blocks.en: Retrieval over a prebuilt index has long been the way a model reaches a corpus beyond its context ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ) , first as a single retrieval step and then, in agentic search, as repeated queries to the same retriever over many rounds ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . Direct corpus interaction departs from this design: rather than a retriever that decides what the agent sees, the agent is given the corpus itself and searches it with terminal tools ( Li et al., 2026b ) . In particular, Dr-DCI ( Lu et al., 2026 ) lets the agent pull retrieved documents into a local workspace (where a workspace denotes the materialized set of pulled documents, whereas here it denotes the files an organization holds), GrepSeek ( Salemi et al., 2026 ) trains compact agents for it, and related work compares terminal or keyword search with vector retrieval ( Sen et al., 2026 ; Subramanian et al., 2026 ) or builds on it ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . However, these works typically target a short answer to a question and improve how an agent reaches the corpus; to our knowledge, none of them records which file meets which requirement of the task. RunningTab instead turns to what becomes of the content once it is reached: it changes nothing about how the agent reaches the files and records, beside the agent, what the task asks for and which opened file each item was closed against.
blocks.zh: 长期以来,对一个预建的指数进行检索一直是一个模型超越上下文的方式(Karpukhin等,2020年;Lewis等,2020年),首先作为单一检索步骤,然后作为代理检索,在许多回合中反复询问同一检索者(Jin等,2025年;Li等,2025年)。 直接的生物体相互作用与这种设计不同:不是一个决定代理人所见的取回器,而是将生物体本身交给代理人,并用终端工具进行搜索(Li等,2026b)。 特别是,Dr-DCI(Lu等人,2026年)让代理人将检索到的文件拉入当地的工作空间(工作空间表示已实现的所取文件,而此处则表示一个组织持有的文件),GrepSeek(Salemi等人,2026年)为其培训紧凑的代理,相关工作将终端或关键词搜索与矢量检索进行比较(Sen等人,2026年;Subramanian等人,2026年)或在此基础上更进一步(Zhuang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年a年)。 然而,这些作品通常针对一个问题的简短答案,并改进代理人如何到达诉讼文书;据我们所知,没有一个文件记录符合任务要求。 运行 标签转而谈到内容一旦达到会变成什么:它不会改变代理如何到达文件与记录,除了代理,任务要求什么,以及打开文件的每个项目被关闭。

blocks.en: Memory for LLM agents is typically written by the model itself and kept across sessions or trials ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) : content is moved out of the context window into external storage and brought back when needed ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , or the agent records its experiences and reflections and retrieves them later ( Park et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025b ) . Beyond memory that outlives a task, the model likewise keeps its own state within a single task: a plan written into its context ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , notes it writes on what it reads ( Lanchantin et al., 2023 ) , a compact internal state it rewrites at each turn ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , or, in multi-agent systems such as Magentic-One ( Fourney et al., 2024 ) , a plan and a progress record that an orchestrator LLM writes and judges. In recent work, such a record is kept for the agent and updated as the task proceeds, by the model itself or by further models that supervise it ( Ko et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . However, wherever these systems keep a record of the task, it is kept by a model, which writes it and marks its items complete. In contrast, in RunningTab, the tab is kept by the environment: the environment writes it from what the agent read and listed (the agent adds only its requirements), its items are marked done only against a captured excerpt or set aside with a reason, and, kept outside the context window, it is not displaced and is returned to the agent once, when it tries to finish.
blocks.zh: LLM剂的内存一般由模型自己书写并贯穿会话或试验(Zhang等,2025年) :内容从上下文窗口移出到外部存储并在需要时带回(Packer等,2023年),或代理记录其经历和反射并稍后取回(Park等,2023年;Shinn等,2023年;Xu等,2025年b). 除了活过一项任务的记忆外,该模型同样将其自身状态维持在一个单一的任务之内:一个写在它的背景中的计划(Wang等人,2023年),它写到它所读的内容(Lanchantin等人,2023年),它在每个转弯处重写一个紧凑的内部状态(Zhou等人,2025年),或者在Magentic-One(Fourney等人,2024年)等多代理系统中,一个管弦乐手写作和评委的计划和进度记录. 在最近的工作中,通过模型本身或监督其的其他模型,为代理人保存这种记录并随着任务的进展而更新(Ko等,2026;Wu等,2026;Ma等,2026)。 然而,只要这些系统对任务有记录,它就由一个模型保存,模型将它写出并标记其项目完成. 相形之下,在"跑讯"(RunningTab)中,标签由环境保存: 环境从代理阅读和列出的内容(代理只添加其要求)中写出,其物品只被标记在被捕获的节选上或被有原因地搁置下,并且保存在上下文窗口外,它不会被转移,当它试图完成时被归还给代理.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we first formalize direct workspace interaction, a setting in which the agent is given access to every file of a workspace but no persistent record of the state of its task, and then present RunningTab, which supplies this record in the form of an environment-side tab kept beside the agent.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先将直接的工作空间交互正式化,这种设置允许代理人访问一个工作空间的每个文件,但没有对其任务状态的持续记录,然后呈现出RunningTab,它以保存在代理人旁边的环境侧分页的形式提供这个记录.

blocks.en: 3.1 Direct Workspace Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.1 直接工作空间互动

blocks.en: Let 𝒲 \mathcal{W} denote a workspace, the collection of files an organization already holds (such as reports, spreadsheets, slide decks, and notes), and let t t denote a task that asks for a new deliverable 𝒟 \mathcal{D} (for instance, a report or a spreadsheet) to be produced from them. What characterizes such a task is that what it asks for rarely sits in one place: t t decomposes into many individual elements (a fact to look up, a figure to extract, a section to write) whose sources are scattered across the files of 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , and the deliverable is complete only when every one of them has been carried into 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . The task is carried out by an agent, an LLM typically equipped with terminal tools (such as read , which opens a file, and bash , which runs a shell command), which works in turns: in each turn, the model issues tool calls and receives their observations, writing 𝒟 \mathcal{D} into an output folder of 𝒲 \mathcal{W} , and it finishes when it responds without a tool call, which we refer to as a stop.
blocks.zh: 让 W\ mathcal{ W} 表示一个工作空间, 一个组织已经保存的文件的集合( 如报告、 电子表格、 幻灯片甲板和注释) , 让 t 表示一个任务, 要求从它们中产生一个新的可交付的 D\ mathcal{ D} (例如报告或电子表格) 。 这种任务的特点在于它要求的东西很少坐在一个地方: t 分解成许多单个元素(一个往上看的事实,一个取出的数字,一个被写出的部分),其来源分散在W\mathcal{W}的文件中,只有当每一个被运入D\mathcal{D}时,才能交付完成. 任务由代理执行,LLM一般配备终端工具(如读取,打开一个文件,并用击打,运行一个 shell 命令),它依次工作:在每一回,模型发布工具调用并接收他们的观察,将 D\ mathcal{D} 写入 W\ mathcal{W} 的输出文件夹中,当它在没有工具调用的情况下响应时完成,我们称之为停用.

blocks.en: To reach the files, the agent follows direct corpus interaction ( Li et al., 2026b ) : instead of querying a retriever over an index, it applies its terminal tools directly to the raw files, so that any file in 𝒲 \mathcal{W} can be listed, searched, and opened as it is. We define direct workspace interaction (DWI) as the setting in which a workspace task is carried out with this form of access: given 𝒲 \mathcal{W} and t t , the agent interacts directly with the files of 𝒲 \mathcal{W} over many turns and hands in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} when it finishes. DWI thus inherits from direct corpus interaction how files are reached, but differs from it in what is asked of the agent: there, the output is a short answer that a few passages typically suffice to support; here, it is a deliverable that brings together content from many files, so that what the agent finds should remain available until it is written into 𝒟 \mathcal{D} .
blocks.zh: 要到达文件,代理遵循了直接实体交互(Li等, 2026b) : 它不通过索引查询检索器,而是将其终端工具直接应用到原始文件上, 这样 W\ mathcal{ 中的任何文件 W}可以被列出,搜索,并打开它现在。 我们定义直接工作空间交互(DWI)为使用这种访问形式执行工作空间任务的设置:给定了 W\ mathcal{W} 和 t t, 代理在完成后在许多转折和手上直接与 W\ mathcal{W} 文件交互. DWI因此继承了直接实体交互是如何到达文件的,但在向代理商询问的内容上却与它不同:在那里,输出是一个简短的答案,一些段落通常足以支持;在这里,它是一个将许多文件的内容汇集在一起的可交付文件,因此代理商发现的东西应该保留到被写入 D\mathcal{D} 为止.

blocks.en: In its plain form, however, DWI leaves this to the context window, where what the agent has found survives only as a passage in a growing stream of observations. To measure how often content shown to the agent is missing from the deliverable, we analyze DCI ( Li et al., 2026b ) , the plain form of DWI, with GPT-5.4 nano ( OpenAI, 2026 ) on Workspace-Bench ( Tang et al., 2026 ) , which checks each deliverable against rubrics, over three runs of its 100 tasks. We assign each rubric that DCI fails to a failure type with LLM annotators (agreeing with human labels at a Cohen’s kappa of 0.83), and check whether each numeric value a rubric expects appears in the observations of the agent and in its deliverable.

blocks.en: Motivated by this, RunningTab is built around an object that keeps such a record, the environment-side tab ( Figure 3 ), a per-task record of what the task still owes, maintained not by the model but by the environment (the loop that runs the model and its tool calls). Next, we define the tab ( Section 3.2 ) and describe how it is kept during the task ( Section 3.3 ) and settled before delivery ( Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Environment-Side Tab
blocks.zh: 3.2 环境系统标签

blocks.en: We now turn to the environment-side tab ( Figure 3 ), the central component of RunningTab, and describe what it consists of, how the environment maintains it, and how the agent accesses it.
blocks.zh: 我们现在转向环境侧标签(图3),即RunningTab的中心部分,并描述它包含什么,环境如何维持,以及代理如何访问。

blocks.en: Recall that a deliverable is assembled from content scattered across many files, often long after that content was first encountered ( Section 3.1 ). Consequently, by the time the agent writes, it should rely on the following (remaining accessible): what the task asks for (so that no element is left out), what it has already read (so that content found earlier can be reused without searching for it again), and which files it has seen in a listing but not yet opened (so that it knows where to look for what is still missing). To this end, the tab maintains one kind of entry for each of them. Formally, for a task t t , the tab is defined as 𝒯 t = ( ℛ , ℒ , 𝒞 ) \mathcal{T}_{t}=(\mathcal{R},\mathcal{L},\mathcal{C}) , which consists of requirements ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ), a read log ( ℒ \mathcal{L} ), and candidates ( 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ), described as follows: • Requirements ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ). The requirements are the individual items that the task asks for, each being one fact, figure, or element of the deliverable. For instance, for a task that asks for a short report with several figures from an annual report, one requirement would be the number of new invention patents in 2024. At the start of the task, the agent states these items, and the environment records each of them as a requirement r i ∈ ℛ r_{i}\in\mathcal{R} and tracks its status from then on. Specifically, a requirement is open when it is recorded, and the agent could later resolve it in one of two ways: as done , when its content has been found in a file, in which case the agent cites the entry of the read log that contains it; or as unavailable , when no file supplies it (for instance, because it is to be computed or written by the agent), in which case the agent states the reason. • Read log ( ℒ \mathcal{L} ). The read log keeps a copy of what the agent has read. Whenever the agent reads a file (by opening it or extracting its text), the environment records an entry ℓ j ∈ ℒ \ell_{j}\in\mathcal{L} , which consists of an excerpt (the content exactly as shown to the model) and an anchor (its provenance: the path of the file and the command that produced it). In the example above, extracting the text of the annual report yields an entry whose excerpt contains the line with the patent count, so it can be found again without reopening the report. • Candidates ( 𝒞 \mathcal{C} ). The candidates are the files the agent has come across but not yet looked into. Whenever a file appears in a listing (such as the output of a command that lists a folder or searches for file names) without having been opened, the environment records it in 𝒞 ⊆ 𝒲 \mathcal{C}\subseteq\mathcal{W} , and removes it once the agent opens it. In the example, if the folder of the annual report also contains a presentation of the same year that the agent has not opened, it remains among the candidates, as a place where a missing figure may still be found. Note that it is the environment, rather than the model itself, that keeps every entry of the tab: it stores the requirements as the agent states them, and it captures the read log and the candidates on its own, since it observes every read and every listing, whereas a record that the model keeps for itself may miss some of them. Moreover, the tab is stored outside the context window, so that its entries are not displaced by new observations, and outside the workspace, so that it is not mixed with the files the agent lists and reads or with the deliverable. In other words, being kept by the environment and stored outside the context window is what distinguishes the tab; a record that the model keeps on its own within its context has neither of these properties.
blocks.zh: 回顾可交付品是根据分散在许多文件中的内容组装而成的,而且往往是在首次接触该内容很久之后(第3.1节)。 因此,在代理写作时,它应该依赖以下内容(仍然可以访问):任务要求什么(因此不遗漏任何元素),它已经读到什么(这样可以重新使用早先发现的内容而无需再搜索),以及它已经在列表中看到但尚未打开的哪些文件(以便知道在哪里寻找仍然缺失的内容). 为此,标签中保留了其中每个条目的一种. 形式上,对于 t t 任务,标签被定义为 T = (R, L, C)\ mathcal{T}_{t}= (\mathcal{R},\mathcal{L},\mathcal{C}),包含要求 (R\mathcal{R}),读取日志 (L\mathcal{L}),以及候选人 (C\mathcal{C}),描述如下: 要求 (R\mathcal{R}). 所需经费是任务要求的单个项目,每个项目都是交付品的一个事实、数字或要素。 例如,要完成一项要求从年度报告中提供若干数字的简短报告的任务,一项要求是2024年新发明专利的数量。 在任务开始时, 代理声明这些项, 环境将每个项记录为 r i \\\ R\\\\\\\\ mathcal{R} , 并跟踪其状态 。 具体来说,一个要求在被记录时是开放的,代理商以后可以两种方式之一解决它: 照做,当其内容被找到在一个文件中,在这种情况下,代理商引用了包含它被读取的日志的条目; 或者,当没有文件提供时(例如,因为它是由代理商计算或编写的),在这种情况下,代理商说明了原因. 二. 支助 读取日志 (L\ mathcal{L}). 所读日志保存着代理所读内容的副本. 当代理读取文件时(通过打开或取出其文本),环境会记录一个条目l j ∈ L\ ell_{j}\in\ mathcal{L},它包含一个节选(内容完全如模型所示)和一个锚(其出处:文件的路径和生成它的命令). 在上述例子中,取出年度报告的正文,产生一个条目,其节选中包含与专利计数的相接部分,因此可以在不重开报告的情况下再次找到. • 候选人(C\mathcal{C})。 候选人是特工发现但尚未调查的文件。 当一个文件出现在列表中(如列出文件夹的命令输出或搜索文件名)而未打开时,环境会在 C \\ W\ mathcal{ C\ subseteq\ mathcal{ W} 中将其记录下来,并在代理打开后将其删除 。 举例来说,如果年度报告的文件夹中还载有该代理人尚未打开的同年的介绍,则它仍然属于候选者之列,因为可能仍然能找到缺失的数字。 请注意,是环境,而不是模型本身保留了标签的每一个条目:它按代理说明的方式存储要求,它自己捕获读取的日志和候选人,因为它观察每一个读取的和每一个列表,而模型为自己保存的记录可能会错过其中一些内容. 此外,标签被存储在上下文窗口外,使其条目不会被新的观察所取代,并在工作空间外,从而不与代理列表的文件相混合并阅读或与可交付文件相混合. 换句话说,被环境所保存并被保存在上下文窗口外,是标签的区别所在;模型在上下文中单独保存的一则记录既没有这些属性.

blocks.en: Since the tab is stored outside the context window, the agent accesses it through four operations. Specifically, two of them update the requirements: add states one or more requirements, and resolve resolves a requirement as done or unavailable . The other two read the tab: list lists the requirements with their status, the candidates, or the entries of the read log, and show returns a single entry of the read log (its excerpt with its anchor), so that content read earlier can be consulted again without reopening the file. We describe when and how these operations are used in the following subsections.
blocks.zh: 由于标签被存储在上下文窗口外,代理通过4个操作访问. 具体地说,其中两项更新了要求:增加一项或多项要求,并按已做或无用解决一项要求。 另外两人读取了分页:列表列出了有他们状态的要求,候选者,或者读取日志的条目,并显示返回读取日志的单个条目(其节选与其主播),这样就可以在不重新打开文件的情况下再次查阅早先读取的内容. 我们叙述这些行动何时以及如何在以下各分节中使用。

blocks.en: 3.3 Keeping the Tab during the Task
blocks.zh: 3.3 任务期间保留标签

blocks.en: We now describe how the tab is kept while the agent works. Since the tab is useful at a given turn only if it already holds what the agent needs then, each kind of entry is recorded as it arises, by the party in a position to record it: the agent states the requirements at the start, while the environment captures reads and listings from the observations and reports the state of the tab alongside them.
blocks.zh: 我们现在描述的是,在代理工作期间,如何保存标签。 由于制表人只有在已经持有代理人当时需要的东西时,才能在特定转弯时使用,所以每一种输入都由能够记录的一方记录:代理人在初始时说明要求,而环境捕捉则从观察中读取和列出,并报告标签的状态。

blocks.en: Of the three kinds of entries, the requirements are the one the environment cannot capture on its own, since what the task asks for appears only in the task, and dividing it into items takes an understanding of the task that the model supplies. RunningTab therefore adds a short block to the system prompt, which asks the agent to begin by stating the requirements with add and then to work as usual.
blocks.zh: 在三种条目中,要求是环境本身无法捕捉到的,因为任务要求只出现在任务中,将任务分为项目需要理解模型提供的任务. 运行 Tab因此给系统提示增加了一个短块,它要求代理商首先用添加来说明要求,然后照常工作.

blocks.en: In contrast, the read log and the candidates need no action from the agent: the environment sees every observation, so it records both on its own. For each observation it decides which files the agent has read and which it has only seen listed. However, the terminal itself draws no such line: many commands read a file, and a single command can show the content of one file with the names of many others. RunningTab therefore draws this line from the command and its observation: a file counts as read when its content appears, and as listed when only its path does. An entry of the read log stores the observation as it is, neither parsed nor summarized, so that capturing depends on no file format and the entry holds what the agent saw. Since one listing can name hundreds of files while a candidate carries only its path, the candidates are ranked by the lexical relevance of their paths to the task with BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) .
blocks.zh: 相形之下,读取的日志和被选取者不需要从剂中取出任何动作:环境会看到每一个观察,因此它会自行记录两种. 对于每项观察,它决定代理人的档案是哪些,它只看到清单所列的。 然而,终端本身并没有画出这样的行:许多命令读取一个文件,一个单一的命令可以显示一个文件的内容并有许多其他文件的名字. 运行 因此 Tab 从命令及其观察中绘制出此行: 文件在内容出现时计数为已读, 在仅其路径出现时计数为已列表 。 已读日志的条目存储了当前观察,既不解析也不摘要,因此捕获取决于没有文件格式,且该条目持有代理商看到的东西. 由于一张名单可以列出数百个文件,而候选人只携带其路径,所以候选人的排名是根据他们与BM25任务路径的逻辑相关性(Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009).

blocks.en: Storing the tab outside the context window keeps its entries from being displaced, but the agent then sees none of them unless it calls an operation. The environment therefore appends to each observation a status line carrying the state of the tab: which requirements remain open , how much the read log and the candidates hold, and how long since its last operation.
blocks.zh: 在上下文窗口外保存标签可以防止其条目被移出,但代理商随后不会看到其中的任何一个,除非它称为操作. 因此,环境在每次观察中都附加了带有标签状态的状态行:哪些要求仍然开放,读取的日志和候选人持有多少,以及上次操作有多长时间。

blocks.en: 3.4 Settling the Tab before Delivery
blocks.zh: 3.4 交付前设置标签

blocks.en: We now describe how the tab is settled before delivery. A requirement stays open until the agent resolves it, so a tab is settled once all its requirements are resolved. RunningTab works toward that state with three mechanisms: a review that shows what may supply each open requirement; a resolution that names where the content of a requirement was found, or why no file supplies it; and a finish check sent at the stop.
blocks.zh: 我们现在描述如何在交货前就解决了帐单。 一项要求在代理解决之前一直保持开放,所以一旦其所有要求得到解决,便会结算分帐. 运行 Tab 向这个状态努力有三种机制: 一份审查, 显示每个开放要求的提供内容; 一份决议, 列出发现要求内容的地方, 或为何没有文件提供; 以及站点发送的完成检查。

blocks.en: Connecting a requirement to the file that supplies it is a link the context window leaves implicit, whereas the tab holds both ends of it: the requirements on one side, the read log and the candidates on the other. RunningTab therefore offers a review that joins them: when the agent lists its requirements with list , the tab returns each open requirement beside the read-log entries that best match it and the unopened files still to try, both ranked by BM25 against the requirement. The prompt asks the agent to do so after exploring and before resolving any requirement, so that it can still act on what the review shows.
blocks.zh: 连接到提供文件的要求是上下文窗口所隐含的链接,而标签则占据文件的两端:一边的要求,阅读日志和另一边的候选人. 运行 因此 Tab 提供了一个加入它们的审查: 当代理以列表列出其要求时, 标签会返回最匹配其的读取条目外的每个打开要求, 以及尚未打开的要尝试的文件, 两者都由 BM25 按要求排序 。 该提示要求代理在探索后和解决任何要求之前这样做,这样它仍然可以就审查显示的内容采取行动.

blocks.en: To resolve a requirement as done , the agent cites the read-log entry its content came from, and the tab checks the citation so that a done rests on what the agent read: resolve refuses a citation whose path and excerpt share no term with the requirement, while unavailable requires a reason.
blocks.zh: 为了解决所要求的问题,代理商引用其内容来自读取条目,制表符检查引用内容,这样一个完成就取决于代理商所读的内容: 解决拒绝一个引用,其路径和摘录与该要求没有同名词,而不能使用则需要一个理由。

blocks.en: To give the agent a final pass over the tab, RunningTab places a check at the stop, the last moment to change the deliverable. At the first stop, the finish check reports the status of the requirements and the files listed but not opened, and asks the agent to add what is missing before finishing again.
blocks.zh: 为了给经纪人一个最后的通过标签,RunningTab在站点放置了一张支票,这是更改交付品的最后时刻. 在第一站,完成检查报告要求的状态和列出但未打开的文件,并要求代理在再次完成之前添加所缺少的内容.

blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Table 1 : Main results on three benchmarks with three LLMs, averaged over three runs (standard deviation in parentheses). Best results within each LLM are bolded ; second best are underlined .

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the benchmarks, the baselines, and the implementation details.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们叙述基准、基线和执行细节。

blocks.en: Direct workspace interaction targets tasks whose deliverable draws on many files of a workspace. We therefore use two benchmarks that pose such tasks and check the deliverable element by element (by rubrics or by checkpoints), and one benchmark of QA over enterprise documents: • Workspace-Bench ( Tang et al., 2026 ) simulates the workspaces of five professional roles (such as an operations manager and a researcher), each holding thousands of heterogeneous files, and asks for deliverables that draw on files scattered across a workspace; it has 100 tasks and 1,850 evaluation instances (one per rubric), on which we report the Rubric Pass Rate (the share of satisfied rubrics) and the Task Completion Rate (TCR@70, the share of tasks with at least 70% of their rubrics satisfied), following its protocol. • TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2025a ) simulates a software company whose tasks are checked by programmatic evaluators at checkpoints; we use a subset of its tasks that need no service other than the file server of the company (such as other websites or external models), with 88 evaluation instances (one per checkpoint), and report Success (the share of tasks whose checkpoints all pass) and Score (which gives each task half credit for the fraction of checkpoint points it earns and half for its success), as proposed by its authors. • OfficeQA Pro ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ) lets us check whether RunningTab also helps in the conventional setting of question answering, where the deliverable is a single answer: its workspace holds 697 files (U.S. Treasury Bulletins spanning nearly a century, about 89,000 pages), and the answer to each question is found, and often computed, from these files. We use a subset of its questions that need no external data source (such as exchange rates or price indices), with 104 evaluation instances (one per question), and report the accuracy at an allowable absolute relative error of 0% and 1% (Acc@0% and Acc@1%), as in its protocol.
blocks.zh: 直接的工作空间交互针对的是那些可交付性可以借鉴一个工作空间的许多文件的任务. 因此,我们使用两个提出这种任务的基准,并按要素(通过标题或检查站)检查可交付要素,以及企业文件的质量保证基准: • Workspace-Bench(Tang等,2026年)模拟5个专业角色(如业务经理和研究员)的工作空间,每个专业角色拥有数千个不同的文件,要求利用分散在一个工作空间的文件交付成果;它有100个任务和1 850个评价例(每个卢布一个),我们报告Rubric通过率(满意分数的比例)和任务完成率(TCR@70,至少70%的分数得到满足),遵循协议。 • AgentCompany(徐等,2025年a)模拟一个软件公司,其任务在检查站由程序评价员检查;我们使用它的一部分任务,除了该公司的文件服务器(例如其他网站或外部模型)不需要其他服务外,还有88个评价实例(每个检查站一个),并报告成功(检查站全部通过的任务份额)和分数(每个任务一半的功劳是它所得的检查站分数,一半的功劳是它的成功)。 • OfficeQA Pro(Opsahl-Ong等,2026年)让我们检查RunningTab是否也帮助常规的问答设置,其中交付品是一个单一的答案:它的工作空间拥有697个文件(《美国财务公报》涵盖近一个世纪,约89 000页),每个问题的答案都从这些文件中找到并经常计算。 我们使用一个不需要外部数据来源(如汇率或价格指数)的问题子集,104个评价实例(每个问题一个),并按允许的绝对相对误差0%和1%(Acc@0%和Acc@1%)报告准确性,如协议所示。

blocks.en: OfficeQA Pro ( Opsahl-Ong et al., 2026 ) lets us check whether RunningTab also helps in the conventional setting of question answering, where the deliverable is a single answer: its workspace holds 697 files (U.S. Treasury Bulletins spanning nearly a century, about 89,000 pages), and the answer to each question is found, and often computed, from these files. We use a subset of its questions that need no external data source (such as exchange rates or price indices), with 104 evaluation instances (one per question), and report the accuracy at an allowable absolute relative error of 0% and 1% (Acc@0% and Acc@1%), as in its protocol.
blocks.zh: OfficeQA Pro(Opsahl-Ong等,2026年)让我们检查RunningTab是否也帮助常规的问答设置,其中交付品是一个单一的答案:它的工作空间拥有697个文件(美国金库公告覆盖了近一个世纪,约89,000页),每个问题的答案都从这些文件中找到,并经常被计算出. 我们使用一个不需要外部数据来源(如汇率或价格指数)的问题子集,104个评价实例(每个问题一个),并按允许的绝对相对误差0%和1%(Acc@0%和Acc@1%)报告准确性,如协议所示。

blocks.en: We compare RunningTab against DCI and against three baselines in which the model, rather than an environment-side tab, keeps track of what the task asks for: • DCI ( Li et al., 2026b ) is direct corpus interaction applied to the workspace: the agent works on the files with terminal tools, leaving the state of the task to its context window. • TODO follows plan-first prompting ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , asking the agent to begin by writing a TODO list of every fact, figure, and deliverable element the task asks for. • Self-Refine ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) has the model review and refine its own output; at the first stop, one message asks the agent to re-check each of these elements against the source files it read and to make sure that each is in the deliverable before finishing again. • Self-Tracking combines the two, as in model-kept records of task progress ( Fourney et al., 2024 ; Ko et al., 2026 ) : the agent lists these elements at the start and re-checks them at the end. • RunningTab is our framework, in which the environment-side tab keeps track of the task.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了RunningTab与DCI以及三个基线,其中模型而不是一个环境侧标签,跟踪任务要求的内容: • DCI(Li等,2026b)是应用于工作空间的直接实体交互:代理在文件上使用终端工具,将任务状态留给其上下文窗口. • TODO遵循计划第一提示(Wang等人,2023年),要求代理商首先写出TODO清单,列出任务要求的每一个事实,数字和可交付要素. • 自读(Madaan等人,2023年)有模型审查,并完善自己的产出;第一站,有一个信息要求代理人对照其读取的出处文件重新检查每个这些要素,并确保每个要素在再次完成前都在交付品中。 ^ 自跟踪结合了两者,如模型-保存的任务进度记录(Fourney等,2024;Ko等,2026):代理商在起始时列出这些元素,并在结尾再检查. · 运行Tab是我们的框架,其中环境侧标签跟踪任务。

blocks.en: Following Li et al. (2026b) , all methods use DCI-Agent-Lite, a terminal agent built on the Pi harness 1 1 1 https://github.com/earendil-works/pi , with its terminal tools (such as read and bash ), a budget of 300 turns, and runtime context management at level 3 (which truncates each observation and clears older observations as they accumulate), to which we add a time limit of one hour per task. We instantiate every method with three LLMs: GPT-5.4 nano ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek V4 Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) . Where the evaluation calls for an LLM judge, we follow the protocol of each benchmark and use GPT-5.4 mini. For RunningTab, the calls to the tab operations are removed from the trajectory that the evaluators read, and its settings stay the same across benchmarks and models. We report the average over three runs.
blocks.zh: 继李等 (2026b)后,所有方法都使用DCI-Agent-Lite,一个基于Pi cape 1 1 1的终端代理 https://github.com/earendil-works/pi,其终端工具(如读取和击出等),预算为300个转弯,运行时间上下文管理为3级(在积累时缩短了每次观测,并清除了更古老的观测),我们为此增加了每个任务一小时的时限. 我们用3个LLMs(GPT-5.4纳米(OpenAI,2026年)),DeepSeek V4 Flash(DeepSeek-AI,2026年),和双子座3.8 Flash(Google DeepMind,2026年)来对每个方法进行即时分析. 在评价需要一名LLM法官时,我们遵循每个基准的协议,并使用GPT-5.4迷你. 对于RunningTab,调用分页操作的调用从评估者读取的轨迹中删除,其设置在基准和模型上保持不变. 我们报告的平均运行时间超过三次。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验结果

blocks.en: We report the main results in Table 1 , where RunningTab achieves the best performance on every benchmark, metric, and LLM. In contrast, the baselines in which the model keeps track of the task (by listing what the task asks for at the start, re-checking the deliverable at the end, or both) remain far less effective, suggesting that the gains of RunningTab come not from instructing the model to keep track of the task but from the record that the environment keeps on its behalf, outside the context window. These gains hold across workspace settings, from assembling deliverables from office files (Workspace-Bench) and carrying out company tasks (TheAgentCompany) to answering questions from decades of archives (OfficeQA Pro).
blocks.zh: 我们在表1中报告了主要结果,其中RunningTab在每一个基准、指标和LLM方面都取得了最佳业绩。 与此相反,模型跟踪任务情况的基线(列出任务开始时要求的,在结尾重新检查可交付品,或者两者都一样)仍然效果低得多,说明运行Tab的收益不是来自指示模型跟踪任务,而是来自环境在上下文窗口外为其保存的记录. 这些收益存在于不同的工作空间环境中,从收集办公室文件(Workspace-Bench)的可交付成果到执行公司任务(代理公司)到回答几十年档案(OfficeQA Pro)的问题。

blocks.zh: 表2:在Workspace-Bench上,标签作为中位数或标记为股份(%)。

blocks.en: To understand what the environment-side tab provides to the agent, we first examine its contents on Workspace-Bench. As shown in Table 3 , the tab holds a substantial record of each task: a median of four to five requirements, 6 to 18 read-log entries (each storing the text that the agent saw when it read a file, together with the path of that file) drawn from 5 to 11 distinct files and holding 12K to 40K characters of excerpted text, and 147 to 294 files that were listed but not opened. Moreover, the review brings this record to each requirement: when the agent pulls the review, 69.9% to 88.0% of its open requirements are shown beside a read-log entry whose excerpt contains a line with words of the requirement, so that, for most requirements, the review points the agent to a matching passage from a file it has already read.
blocks.zh: 为了了解环境侧标签为代理人提供什么,我们首先审查它的内容在Workspace-Bench上. 如表3所示,分页对每项任务都有实质性记录:中位数为4至5个要求,6至18个读取日志条目(每个存储代理在读取文件时看到的文本,以及文件的路径)从5至11个不同的文件并持有取出文本的12K至40K字符,147至294个被列出但未打开的文件. 此外,审查使这一记录符合每项要求:当代理商拉动审查时,其开放要求的69.9%至88.0%被显示在一个读取条目旁边,该条目的节选包含与要求的单词相通的一行,因此,对于大多数要求,审查将代理商指向它已经读取的文件的匹配段落.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : RunningTab with GPT-5.4 nano on Workspace-Bench (%). (Left) Values held in the tab, among those the agent was shown but its deliverable lacks. (Right) Held values that an LLM recovers when they are masked, by the part of the tab given.
blocks.zh: 图4:工作空间-奔驰上带有GPT-5.4纳米的运行Tab(%). (左传). 标签中包含的值,其中显示的是代理商,但其交付品缺乏。 (右) 所持值为LLM被遮住后恢复的值, 由给定的标签部分进行 。

blocks.en: With DCI, about one in five of the rubric values shown to the agent is absent from its deliverable ( Figure 2 , bottom). We check whether, with RunningTab, such values are held in the tab: for each numeric value that a failed rubric expects, that appears in an observation of the agent, and that is absent from the deliverable, we test whether the read log stores it. As shown in Figure 4 (left), with GPT-5.4 nano, the tab holds 94.8% of these values 2 2 2 The read log keeps only file content ( Section 3.3 ), not a value the agent computes (such as a sum) or sees only in a listing. , so the missing content has in most cases been captured by the environment. We further test whether it is usable: for the requirements whose values the deliverable left out entirely, the same LLM, given the task and the requirement with its values masked, recovers 8.4% of the values held in the tab without the tab, 45.8% from the review of the tab for that requirement and the entries it chooses to open, and 78.1% from the whole read log ( Figure 4 , right), so the review brings back more than half of what the full log provides while using a small fraction of its text. Consistently, RunningTab succeeds on more rubrics in the Shown but Missing category ( Figure 2 , top) than DCI (27.0% against 20.7%).
blocks.zh: 在DCI中,向代理显示的面值约有五分之一没有出现在其可交付性中(图2,下方)。 我们用 RunningTab 来检查这些值是否在标签中被持有: 对于一个失败的面值所期望的每个数值, 在代理物的观察中出现, 而在交付物中缺失的, 我们来测试读取的日志是否存储它 。 如图4(左)所示,由于GPT-5.4纳米,标签中包含这些值的94.8% 2 2 读取日志只保留文件内容(第3.3节),而不是代理计算值(如总和)或仅在列表中看到. ,因此大部分缺失的内容都被环境所捕捉. 我们进一步测试它是否可用:对于那些被交付的值完全忽略的要求,鉴于任务和要求被掩盖,同样的LLM在不带标签的情况下,回收了8.4%的标签所持有的值,45.8%来自对该要求及其选择打开的条目的审查,78.1%来自整个读取日志(图4,右),因此审查带回了完整日志所提供值的一半以上,同时使用了一小部分文本。 与DCI(27.0%对20.7%)相比,RunningTab在Shown-Missing类(图2,上)中成功。

blocks.en: We then examine how the agent operates the tab, reported in Table 3 , which shows that each LLM draws on the tab in its own way. Specifically, Gemini 3.8 Flash works mainly through the review: it states its requirements and pulls the review before the finish check in every analyzed attempt, and in 76.9% of attempts it resolves a requirement as done by citing a read-log entry that the review listed for that requirement. GPT-5.4 nano instead relies on the finish check: it often turns to the tab only when the check prompts it, and after the check it operates the tab in 72.6% of attempts and edits its deliverable in 17.1%; it also re-reads stored entries with show in 74.6% of attempts. Lastly, DeepSeek V4 Flash works mainly through the candidates: like Gemini 3.8 Flash, it states its requirements before the finish check in every analyzed attempt, but it then explores more widely, reading the most distinct files (a median of 11 in Table 3 ) and opening a file that the tab listed as not yet opened in 54.7% of attempts.
blocks.zh: 然后我们检查毒剂如何操作表3中报告的标签,其中显示每个LLM都以自己的方式从标签上提取. 特别是双子座3.8 Flash主要通过审查进行工作:在每次分析的尝试中,它都说明其要求,并在完成检查之前拉动审查;在76.9%的尝试中,它通过引用审查为该项要求列出的读取条目来解决一项要求。 GPT-5.4纳米取而代之依赖于收尾检查:它常常只在收尾检查提示时才转向分页,在收尾检查后,它以72.6%的尝试来操作分页,以17.1%的尝试来编辑可交付;它还以74.6%的尝试来重读存储的条目并显示. 最后,DeepSeek V4号机 Flash主要通过候选人进行工作:与双子座 3.8 Flash一样,它在每次被分析的尝试中都会在完成检查前说明其要求,但随后会更广泛地探索,读取最不同的文件(表3中位数为11个)并打开一个标签列出的尚未在54.7%的尝试中打开的文件.

blocks.en: To examine how much each component of the environment-side tab contributes to the performance gains, we remove one component at a time on Workspace-Bench with GPT-5.4 nano and report the results in Table 4 . From this, we observe that removing any of the four components lowers both the Pass Rate and TCR@70, indicating that each of them plays a role in these gains. Among them, removing the environmental capture (in which the environment no longer records the read log and the candidates, so that the review and the evidence check, which draw on them, are removed as well) leads to the largest drop in Pass Rate, down to the level of DCI (41.36 against 41.63), which indicates that the gains of RunningTab come largely from what the environment captures on its own, namely the files that the agent reads and lists. Following this, removing the review leads to the next largest drop, which suggests that the captured excerpts are most useful when the agent sees them beside the requirements they match. Lastly, the evidence check and the finish check complement the capture and the review at two moments of the task: when the agent resolves a requirement as done , the evidence check keeps that resolution grounded in what the agent read, and when the agent stops, the finish check gives it a final pass over the tab before delivery.
blocks.zh: 为了审查环境侧标签中每个部分对性能收益的贡献,我们用GPT-5.4纳米在Workspace-Bench上一次删除一个部分,并在表4中报告结果。 由此可见,删除其中任何四个组件都会降低通过率和TCR@70,表明它们各自在这些增益中发挥作用。 其中去除环境捕捉(环境不再记录已读日志和候选者,从而从中取出审查和证据检查),导致通过率下降幅度最大,降至DCI(41.36对41.63),这表明"跑动Tab"的收益主要来自于环境捕捉到的自身,即代理商读取并列出的文件. 之后,删除审查导致次大跌出,这表明当特工在他们匹配的要求之外看到被捕获的节录时最有用. 最后,证据检查和完成检查在任务的两个时刻补充了抓取和审查:当代理人如实解决一项要求时,证据检查保持了根据代理人所读到的解析度,当代理人停止时,完成检查在交付前将最后通过分页。

blocks.en: Since the tab keeps what the agent has read outside the context window, its benefit is expected to grow with how much the agent reads. To see whether this holds, we split the tasks of Workspace-Bench into thirds by reading volume (the characters that the agent receives from its reads and shell commands). As shown in Figure 5 , the gain of RunningTab over DCI generally grows with reading volume across the three LLMs, which indicates that the tab is most valuable when the agent has the most to keep track of (on average, the gain on the third of tasks with the most reading is twice that on the third with the least). Also, it is worth noting that the reading-heavy tasks are where DCI performs worst (its Pass Rate drops by 16 to 27 points from the lightest to the heaviest third); this suggests that the content read earlier remains in the context yet goes unused as observations accumulate, which is precisely what the tab keeps within reach.
blocks.zh: 由于标签将代理阅读的内容保存在上下文窗口外,其好处预计随着代理阅读量的增长而增加. 为了看这是否维持,我们通过读取音量(代理从它的读取和 shell 命令得到的字符)将Workspace-Bench的任务分成了第3个. 如图5所示,RunningTab在DCI之上的增益一般随着三个LLMs的读取量而增长,这表明当代理商最能跟踪时,分页最有价值(平均而言,读取量最高的任务第三的增益是读取量最少的任务第三的两倍). 另外,值得注意的是,阅读-重力任务是DCI执行最差的任务(其传出率从最轻到最重的第三,下降16至27分);这说明早先读取的内容仍然留在上下文中,但随着观察的积累,还没有被使用,这正是制表符所能达到的.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we presented RunningTab, a framework for direct workspace interaction, the setting in which an agent searches and reads the files of a workspace from a terminal to produce a deliverable. Motivated by the observation that what the task asks for and what the agent has read are typically left to the context window, we equipped the agent with an environment-side tab: a per-task record that the environment keeps outside the context window. Specifically, the agent states the requirements, and the environment records each read as an excerpt with its source and each file listed but not opened as a candidate. The agent can then review each open requirement beside its best-matching excerpts and candidates, resolve it by citing the excerpt that supplies it or by giving a reason, and receive a finish check at its stop. Empirical evaluations on three benchmarks with three LLMs show that RunningTab improves over direct workspace interaction alone and over baselines in which the model itself keeps track of the task. Ablations attribute most of this gain to what the environment captures on its own, and the tab usually holds the values a deliverable needs once seen. We believe these findings position the environment-side tab as a natural complement to direct access: terminal tools let the agent reach any file, and the tab keeps track of the task until the deliverable is handed in.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们介绍了RunningTab,这是一个直接工作空间互动的框架,即代理从终端搜索和读取工作空间文件生成可交付文件的设置. 动机在于观察任务的要求和代理阅读的内容通常留给上下文窗口,我们为代理设置了一个环境侧标签:环境保存在上下文窗口外的每任务记录. 具体地说,代理商陈述了要求,环境记录则各自作为摘要阅读,其中包含其来源,以及列出但没有作为候选人打开的每个文件. 然后,代理商除了其最匹配的节选和候选人之外,还可以审查每一项开放要求,通过引用提供该节选的节选或给出理由予以解决,并在停站时收到完成检查。 对三个基准进行的经验性评价,包括三个LLMs,表明RunningTab改进了直接的工作空间互动,不仅改进了模型本身跟踪任务的基线。 缩放将大部分这些收益归结于环境自己捕获的东西,而标签通常会持有一旦看到可交付的需求的值. 我们认为这些发现将环境-侧标签定位为直接访问的自然补充:终端工具让代理到达任何文件,而标签则保持对任务的跟踪,直到交付品交付.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work aims to improve how LLM agents produce deliverables from the files of a workspace, using existing models and public benchmarks. However, agents with RunningTab may retain the biases and errors of their models, and since the tab stores excerpts of the files the agent reads, it may hold sensitive content in real workspaces. We therefore encourage safeguards, such as keeping the tab under the same access controls as the workspace and reviewing the deliverables, when deploying such agents in real-world settings.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的目的是利用现有模型和公共基准,改进LLM代理人如何从工作空间的文档中产生可达到的目标。 然而,带有RuningTab的代理可能保留其模型的偏差和出错,由于标签存储了代理所读取的文件节录,它可能在真实的工作空间中持有敏感的内容. 因此,我们鼓励保障措施,例如在现实世界环境中部署此类人员时,在与工作空间相同的准入控制下进行跟踪,并审查可交付成果。

blocks.en: A.2 Case Study 1: Tracking Every Source of a Deliverable
blocks.zh: A.2 个案研究 1. 追踪可交付品的每个来源

blocks.en: As the first case study, we compare DCI and RunningTab with the same LLM on a task that asks for a water and electricity saving manual compiled from four policy files ( Table 6 ). Although both methods read the same four files within a few turns, they differ in what they keep track of. DCI writes the manual soon after reading the files, leaving the state of the task to its context window. In contrast, with RunningTab, the agent first states one requirement per policy file (A), and the environment records each file it reads as a read-log entry (B); after writing the manual, the agent sees each requirement beside its matching entries in the review (C), resolves it against the entry of its own file (D), and receives a finish check confirming that none is left open (E). In the end, the manual of RunningTab keeps all five chapters and twenty articles of the policy in their original order, whereas that of DCI merges them into an outline of its own and loses the chapter structure.
blocks.zh: 作为第一个案例研究,我们比较了DCI和RunningTab与同一个LLM,一项任务需要从四个政策档案中汇编出节水和节电手册(表6)。 虽然两种方法在几个回合内读取相同的4个文件,但它们在追踪的内容上却有所不同. DCI在读取了文件后不久就写出手册,将任务状态留给了上下文窗口. 相比之下,与RunningTab相比,代理商首先对每个政策文件(A)提出一个要求,环境记录每个文件作为读取日志条目(B);在写出手册后,代理商会在审查(C)中的匹配条目外看到每个要求,根据自己文件(D)的输入解决,并收到一个完成检查,确认没有一个文件没有被打开(E). 最终,"跑讯"的手册将政策的五章和二十条按原顺序保留下来,而"DCI"则将它们合并为自己的大纲并失去章节结构.

blocks.en: A.3 Case Study 2: Backing Every Row with Its Source
blocks.zh: A.3 案例研究2:用资料来源支持每一行

blocks.en: As the second case study, we consider a task that asks for a table summarizing ten purchase orders by supplier ( Table 7 ), where every order is expected in its own row. With DCI, the agent reads the orders one at a time, including that of Supplier 15 with the largest amount (¥55,000), yet the table it writes holds a single row, so the suppliers it has read do not reach the deliverable. With RunningTab, the environment records each order as a read-log entry as the agent reads it. Then, when the finish check reminds the agent that no requirement is recorded, the agent states one requirement per row, naming the supplier, status, amount, and source order, and resolves each against the entry of that order (such as the row of Supplier 15 against L12). In the end, the table of RunningTab holds a row for every supplier, each tied in the tab to the order it comes from.
